classification: CPU-only compensated-FP64 local material derivative self-consistency sweep at captured centers; no native FP32 noise floor, native matrix qualification, or physical solver qualification

scope.perturbation: F +/- epsilon * E_j in captured local F coordinates; rate-independent captured law; accepted history held fixed

limits: This is local constitutive FP64 self-consistency for nine basis directions at one captured center and fixed accepted history.
The grid is ideal FP64 F perturbations; it does not realize FP32 endpoints or measure native arithmetic noise.
Rows without a resolved pair remain inconclusive; zero reference directions cannot be judged by relative error.
One-sided statistics are retained but do not substitute for the centered same-branch gate.
No native cached tangent comparison is performed by this audit; see parent native layers for its own captured-direction comparison.
No full solver, mesh/time convergence, material calibration, or physical qualification.
